attribution.note: Marcus states the prices and recent rally in his own voice.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves both dated quotations and the recent-rally qualifier without asserting that September 11 was the peak.

contract.note: Whole-dollar rounding, daily closing quotations, and a substantial rally during the current week are fair ordinary readings of the statement.

evidence.note: The filing reports an April 15, 2026 ORCL closing price of $169.81, rounding to $170. It cites Bloomberg market data and was available before the cutoff.
The filing reports a September 11, 2025 ORCL close of $307.86, rounding to $308. It cites Bloomberg market data and was available before the cutoff.
Contemporaneous reporting documents an 18% gain through April 14 during the current week, supporting the substantial recent-rally qualifier.

reviews.rationale: The two dated closing prices round to Marcus's quotations, and contemporaneous reporting establishes a substantial rally immediately before his post. The packet identifies no material counterevidence; the excluded adjusted-price series would measure a different basis.
